body.transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.620 --> 00:00:03.500
I had someone ask me today in a comment,

00:00:03.501 --> 00:00:07.020
they were like, how many bank accounts do you have?

00:00:07.021 --> 00:00:08.880
Since you're always talking about,

00:00:08.940 --> 00:00:11.340
you know, I budget for this and I budget for this,

00:00:11.341 --> 00:00:13.020
and I've got a line item for that like,

00:00:13.021 --> 00:00:15.160
how many accounts do you have?
